{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies kernel error definitions and the C/C++ notification interface in src/kernel/error.h, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, and src/kernel/notifications_interface.h to remove UI translation from libbitcoinkernel.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces string-based error notifications across the kernel boundary with typed error structures to remove util/translation.h from libbitcoinkernel. This directly advances the project's core goal of decoupling node dependencies from the kernel library under tracking issue #27587."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/validation.cpp are restricted to error notification invocations and do not touch transaction pool acceptance, eviction, or policy.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch or affect mempool logic or policy rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Mechanical update in src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp to accommodate the notification interface change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The minor edit to bitcoin-chainstate merely adapts the binary to the updated kernel interface."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp solely to wire through updated notification handlers, not shared utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change pertains specifically to kernel error types and notifications rather than general node utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Although labeled Validation and touching src/validation.cpp, the changes only adapt call sites to the new kernel notification signatures without changing validation logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Kernel boundary refactors passing through validation files without altering validation logic or chainstate semantics are explicitly excluded from validation."
    }
  ],
